score: weighted daily Sharpe + 0.25*weighted annualized log growth - 0.5*recent Sharpe dispersion - 2*worst absolute drawdown
short_admission: At least 8 development short cycles, positive aggregate development short PnL and no deterioration of recent-validation return or Sharpe versus the identical long-only profile.
tie_break: Prefer long-only, then slower regime, when scores differ by less than 0.05.
selection_execution: 1h OHLC proxy, previous-bar targets, stop-first, adverse gaps, 4 bps taker plus 2 bps slippage each way; true funding events; no maker fee advantage
final_execution: 1m contract and mark prices, funding, impact, quantity rounding, margin checks; baseline and new strategy use identical fee assumptions; daily Sharpe
holdout_policy: Freeze selected parameters before calculating any holdout metrics. Never rerank or tune using holdout outcomes.
disclosure: 2025-2026 was viewed by earlier repository research. This is a chronological holdout from this search, not historically unseen data. Increased trading frequency does not create independent market regimes. ETF causation is not established.
